en: A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European spa town nestled in a valley, with dense historic buildings, church towers, colonnades and a river or canal running through the center. Forested hills rise in the background. At the bottom, red printed German text identifies the scene as "Karlsbad. Blick von Cafe Panorama." and the publisher "1315 Brück & Sohn, Meissen." The number 1315 is also handwritten in red at the top.
